_readme: Per-app JS budgets, gzip KB (TASK-031). Seeded from the current build plus a small margin so the gate is meaningful immediately; TASK-022 tightens initial budgets to the architecture targets (storefront ≤ 100, admin ≤ 250) and becomes blocking there. `initialKb` counts SvelteKit entry+chunks; SPA builds have no initial convention yet, so their initial is reported but not enforced, and the per-route `routeKb` carries the budget. The SPA per-chunk `chunkKb` still caps every non-route chunk. TASK-032 re-lowered the SvelteKit initial budgets after sharding the i18n catalogs by surface: the storefront dropped 180 → 88 and marketing 150 → 50 (measured 86.1 / 48.2) because neither app ships admin/platform strings anymore. The SPA `initialKb` values are inert (unmeasured build shape) and stay as-is.
